name: The Listening Ladder

scoring.report_note: Report pair-level deltas only. Never rank individuals — the exercise measures how a pair moves up the listening ladder together, not who listens better alone.

description: Two-minute pre/post measure for The Listening Ladder. Scores at pair level: how far did instruction, paraphrase, reflection and repair climb between round A (literal only), round B (add feeling) and round C (add what was left unsaid)?

instructions.pre: Before pairing up. Each participant answers alone, about their own last week at work — not about the exercise.
instructions.post: Immediately after the debrief. Same items, now answered about the ladder just climbed, as a pair.

items.pre_text: Before I answer someone, I restate what I heard them say.
items.post_text: In rounds B and C, we restated before we replied.

items.pre_text: I name the feeling under what a colleague says, not only the facts.
items.post_text: In round B we named the feeling, not only the facts.

items.pre_text: I ask what is left unsaid before I assume I have the whole picture.
items.post_text: In round C we asked what was left unsaid before assuming.

items.pre_text: When someone describes a problem, I quickly relate it back to my own experience.
items.post_text: In round C we kept the focus off our own story and on theirs.

items.pre_text: When I realise I misheard, I go back and re-listen rather than plough on.
items.post_text: When a validator card said 'not yet', we re-listened before moving on.

report.title: The Listening Ladder — pair climb delta
sections: Round A vs round B vs round C validator-card counts
One rung to practise next, chosen per pair from the smallest positive delta
